# authwise_issuer_domain_binding (Resource)

Where an issuer answers: one of the tenant's domains at a path, so the issuer's URL (`iss`) is `https://<hostname><path>`. An issuer may have no binding, one, or several, each its own `iss`; one domain serves several issuers at different paths. There is no update: changing `domain_id` or `path` replaces the binding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authwise_domain" "native" {
  hostname = "acme.id.authwise.com"
}

resource "authwise_domain" "login" {
  custom   = true
  hostname = "login.acme.com"
}

# Two issuers, each on its own host: one host and path serve one issuer.
resource "authwise_issuer" "staff" {}

resource "authwise_issuer" "customers" {}

resource "authwise_issuer_domain_binding" "staff" {
  issuer_id = authwise_issuer.staff.issuer_id
  domain_id = authwise_domain.native.domain_id
}

resource "authwise_issuer_domain_binding" "customers" {
  issuer_id = authwise_issuer.customers.issuer_id
  domain_id = authwise_domain.login.domain_id
}

output "customers_issuer_url" {
  value = authwise_issuer_domain_binding.customers.url # https://login.acme.com
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The domain (`d-…`) of the issuer's tenant, `authwise_domain.<name>.domain_id`: native, or custom. Never a product's host (`DOMAIN_NOT_BINDABLE`). Changing it replaces the binding.

### Optional

- `issuer_id` (String) The issuer (`i-…`), `authwise_issuer.<name>.issuer_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `path` (String) `""` (or unset) for the domain's root, else a path such as `/customers`. kit accepts only the root until path-prefixed issuers route (kit#876), and `/admin` and below are reserved for the tenant's administration console. One (domain, path) serves one issuer: another issuer there is refused (`BINDING_TAKEN`). Changing it replaces the binding.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) `created_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `hostname` (String) The domain's hostname.
- `issuer_domain_binding_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `routable` (Boolean) Whether kit answers here now: always on a native domain; on a custom one once its certificate is live (`PROVISIONING`, `ACTIVE` or `DEGRADED`). A binding may be made before then.
- `url` (String) The binding's issuer URL (`iss`): `https://<hostname><path>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The full resource name.
terraform import authwise_issuer_domain_binding.customers tenants/t-01/issuers/i-01/issuer-domain-bindings/idb-01
```
